change.title: stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields

source.quote: Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

tasks.reasoning:
The repo pins stripe-node 14.13.0, whose default/pinned API version is 2023-10-16. Stripe keeps old pinned versions working, so nothing breaks today without an upgrade. Staying current means one move to stripe-node 23 (2026-09-30.endive), which crosses majors 15–22 and the basil, clover, dahlia and endive API versions. The concrete break is payment_method_types on checkout.sessions.create (controller:102), which returns 400 on endive. Other risks: the subscription and invoice response shapes the webhook handler and src/lib/stripe.ts read (basil moved current_period_end and invoice.subscription), the apiVersion literal type, and ES6 class construction from 22.0.0. The migration agent should check whether src/lib/stripe.ts sets apiVersion explicitly and grep for current_period_end, invoice.subscription and similar fields. It should also confirm no @stripe/stripe-js redirectToCheckout usage exists. Urgency is medium: the SDK is badly outdated, the Checkout and subscription billing path is revenue-critical, and the upgrade itself is where breakage happens, but there is no forced cutoff.
This task also resolves these changes. Handle each in the same change, and say in the PR how:
- stripe:2026-09-30-endive-api-version (api-version): New API major 2026-09-30.endive carries breaking changes; pin it via Stripe-Version or upgrade SDKs (node 23, python 16, go v87), effective 2026-09-30. stripe-node 23.0.0 pins 2026-09-30.endive. Moving to this SDK is the API-version move, so its breaking changes are handled in the same PR.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "As the first version in the Endive release, `2026-09-30.endive` introduces both breaking changes and new features."
- stripe:2026-09-30-remove-payment-method-types-checkout (field-removed): payment_method_types removed from Checkout Sessions create, and paymentMethodTypes option removed from Elements deferred intents (Stripe.js), effective 2026-09-30. checkout.sessions.create in src/trpc/controller/index.ts:102 passes payment_method_types. It only fails once the repo is on endive, so the param must be dropped as part of this bump (rely on dynamic payment methods or Dashboard settings).
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/endive.md
  "We [removed the `payment_method_types` parameter from Checkout Sessions]"
- stripe:2026-03-25-dahlia-api-version (api-version): API major 2026-03-25.dahlia with breaking changes (Checkout ui_mode enum values, events_from on event destinations, Capabilities risk requirements, Stripe.js method removals), effective 2026-03-25. An intermediate API major crossed on the way to endive. Its breaking items (ui_mode enum, events_from, Capabilities, Stripe.js) are checked in the same upgrade. None of them appear to be used here.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog/dahlia.md
  "As the first version in the Dahlia release, `2026-03-25.dahlia` introduces both breaking changes and new features"
- stripe:node-22-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 22.0.0: Stripe is a true ES6 class (use new Stripe()), types reworked, per-request host override removed, effective 2026-04-02. An intermediate major crossed when going from 14.13.0 to 23. The client must be constructed with new Stripe(), and types were reworked, so check src/lib/stripe.ts.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Stripe import is now a true ES6 class. Use `new Stripe()` to create a StripeClient instead of calling it:"
- stripe:node-21-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 21.0.0: pins 2026-03-25.dahlia, drops Node 16, decimal_string fields become Stripe.Decimal, wrong webhook parsing method throws, effective 2026-03-25. An intermediate major crossed in the jump. Node 16 support was dropped, decimal_string fields became Stripe.Decimal, and calling the wrong webhook parsing method now throws. Verify that webhooks.constructEvent in the webhook route still gets a raw body and the signature.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "All `decimal_string` fields changed type from `string` to `Stripe.Decimal` in both request params and response objects."
- stripe:node-20-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 20.0.0: pins 2025-11-17.clover; v2 array params use indexed serialization (may break mock-server tests), effective 2025-11-18. An intermediate major crossed in the jump. It pins 2025-11-17.clover and changes v2 array serialization, which the repo does not use. It is covered by the same bump.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "This may break any unit tests that expect the latter behavior when setting up a mock server."
- stripe:node-19-0-0 (sdk-major): stripe-node (npm) 19.0.0: pins 2025-09-30.clover; parseThinEvent renamed parseEventNotification, v2 delete returns V2DeletedObject, v2 nullable props optional; 19.x deprecated (Files API timeout bug), effective 2025-09-30. An intermediate major crossed in the jump. parseThinEvent was renamed and v2 delete shapes changed, neither used here. It is covered by the same bump.
  Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md
  "Rename function `StripeClient.parseThinEvent` to `StripeClient.parseEventNotification` and remove the `Stripe.ThinEvent` interface."
- stripe:runtime-go-1-24-drop (sdk-major): stripe-go will drop Go 1.24 in March 2027 major; Python 3.9 (stripe-python) March 2027; Node 20 (stripe-node) September 2027, effective 2027-03. The notice also says stripe-node drops Node 20 in its September 2027 major. That is a runtime-support note for this SDK upgrade path, so confirm the deploy runtime is Node 20 or later now and plan for Node 22 or later.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/sdks/versioning.md
  "We’ll drop support for it in the September 2027 major release."
- stripe:2026-09-30-other-breaking-endive (other): Other breaking Endive 2026-09-30 items (unsure which apply): BLIK decline codes, eventually-due requirement errors on Accounts, Failed Tax Calculation error, SEPA debit settings in Accounts, Payment Evaluation nullable scores, 3DS Data Share Only, dispute evidence page limit, India mandates, effective 2026-09-30. These are miscellaneous endive breaking items: BLIK, Accounts requirements, Tax, SEPA, Payment Evaluation, 3DS, disputes and India mandates. They only take effect on the endive pin. The repo uses only Checkout, Billing Portal, Subscriptions and webhooks, so none look relevant, but the migration agent should confirm while doing the bump.
  Source: https://docs.stripe.com/changelog.md
  "Returns specific decline codes for BLIK payment failures"

callSites.why: checkout.sessions.create passes payment_method_types, which is removed on 2026-09-30.endive and must be deleted.

subscriptions.retrieve response shape changed across 2025-03-31.basil and later; current_period_end moved to subscription items. Check which fields the code reads. The stripe client construction and apiVersion literal in this file must also be updated, since new Stripe() is required and the TS type only accepts the pinned version.
webhooks.constructEvent: under the new API version the event payload shapes change, and from 21.0.0 the SDK throws if the wrong parsing method is used. Verify the signature check and event typing.
subscriptions.retrieve is called after checkout.session.completed. Subscription fields read here (e.g. current_period_end, items.data[0].price.id) may have moved under the new API version.

subscriptions.retrieve is called on invoice events. Invoice.subscription moved under parent.subscription_details in basil and later, and subscription period fields moved to items. Check what the handler reads.
billingPortal.sessions.create is likely unchanged. Re-check typings after the SDK major bump.

## stripe-node (npm) 23.0.0: pins 2026-09-30.endive; removes Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification, ErrorType export, V2List V1-only fields [Needs review]

### Change

Upgraded stripe 14.13.0 → 23.0.0 via npm. Removed payment_method_types from checkout.sessions.create. Webhook now reads current_period_end from subscription.items.data[0], and the invoice.payment_succeeded branch gets the subscription id from invoice.parent.subscription_details.subscription. Added tests/stripe-migration.test.mjs. src/lib/stripe.ts already used new Stripe() with no apiVersion, so it needed no change. constructEventWithoutVerification isn't used anywhere.

Files touched:
- `package-lock.json`
- `package.json`
- `src/app/api/webhooks/stripe/route.ts`
- `src/trpc/controller/index.ts`
- `tests/stripe-migration.test.mjs`

### Why

SDK 23 pins API 2026-09-30.endive, which removes payment_method_types from Checkout Sessions create. Types also dropped Subscription.current_period_end (moved to items in basil) and Invoice.subscription (moved to parent.subscription_details).

> Removed the function `Stripe.constructEventWithoutVerification()` that was mistakenly added in version 22.5.0 of this package.

Source: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/stripe/stripe-node/HEAD/CHANGELOG.md

### Proof

| Check | Before | After | New failures |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| typecheck | pass | pass | 0 |
| build | pass | pass | 0 |
| stripe-migration | fail (1) | pass | 0 |

New failures: 0

Checks added by the agent (they count toward proof; check that each command really tests the change):
- stripe-migration, added by the agent: `export DATABASE_URL='mysql://user:pass@localhost:3306/db' KINDE_CLIENT_ID='placeholder' KINDE_CLIENT_SECRET='placeholder' KINDE_ISSUER_URL='https://jiro.kinde.com' KINDE_SITE_URL='http://localhost:3000' KINDE_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL='http://localhost:3000' KINDE_POST_LOGIN_REDIRECT_URL='http://localhost:3000/dashboard' UPLOADTHING_SECRET='placeholder' UPLOADTHING_APP_ID='placeholder' PINECONE_API_KEY='placeholder' PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT='placeholder' PINECONE_INDEX='placeholder' OPENAI_API_KEY='placeholder' STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET='placeholder' STRIPE_SECRET_KEY='placeholder'; node tests/stripe-migration.test.mjs` (fail (1) → pass)

Provider tool calls recorded by the harness:
- `stripe__stripe_check_params`: pass

The agent's validator claims (not proof; graded against the recorded calls):
- stripe__stripe_check_params: pass (POST /v1/checkout/sessions params checked against the endive spec: no problems)

Prepared before the baseline:
- Before the baseline the harness ran `npx prisma generate` (The repo's postinstall (prisma generate) did not run with install scripts off; the Prisma client must be generated so @prisma/client types and imports resolve for tsc and next build.); it exited 0.
- Checks ran with placeholder env: DATABASE_URL, KINDE_CLIENT_ID, KINDE_CLIENT_SECRET, KINDE_ISSUER_URL, KINDE_SITE_URL, KINDE_POST_LOGOUT_REDIRECT_URL, KINDE_POST_LOGIN_REDIRECT_URL, UPLOADTHING_SECRET, UPLOADTHING_APP_ID, PINECONE_API_KEY, PINECONE_ENVIRONMENT, PINECONE_INDEX, OPENAI_API_KEY, STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET, STRIPE_SECRET_KEY.

Test of this change: `stripe-migration`, written by the agent and run with the checks.

Where checks ran: Docker container node:22-bookworm; install scripts disabled; no host env or mounts besides the repo copy; no credentials, so no live API calls

### Unproven

- The webhook's invoice.payment_succeeded path now uses invoice.parent.subscription_details.subscription. This is only type-checked, not run against a real event.
- The webhook handler's session.metadata.userId check runs on the invoice event too, and invoice objects have no such metadata, so that branch may return early. This is existing behaviour that I did not change.
- Webhook endpoint API version in the Stripe dashboard is not checked. It should match the new pin so event shapes match the types.
- The deploy runtime was not checked. Stripe SDK 23 needs Node 20 or later.

### Behaviour changes

- Checkout no longer restricts payment methods to card and paypal. Methods now come from dynamic payment methods / Dashboard settings.
- The pinned API version moves from 2023-10-16 to 2026-09-30.endive, so response shapes change (subscription period end, invoice subscription reference).

---

review.summary: The upgrade jumps the SDK from 14.13 to 23.0, which moves the pinned API version from 2023-10-16 to 2026-09-30.endive. The diff handles the two breaking shape changes this code touches: `current_period_end` moving onto subscription items, and the invoice subscription ID moving under `parent.subscription_details`. The constructEventWithoutVerification removal named in the quote doesn't affect this repo; it was never called. There are three concerns. Removing `payment_method_types` is a product behaviour change the cited quote does not require. Webhook payload shapes depend on the endpoint's API version set in the Stripe Dashboard, not the SDK pin. The added test only greps source text. typecheck and build passing shows the new field paths exist in the v23 types, but nothing exercises a real webhook or checkout. needs-review is the right grade.

concerns.issue: Line 105 removes `payment_method_types: ['card', 'paypal']` from `checkout.sessions.create`. The quoted change does not require this, and I couldn't confirm the parameter was removed in 23.0.0; if it was, typecheck would have failed. Without it, Checkout uses the payment methods enabled in the Dashboard. PayPal could disappear, or methods the owner didn't choose could appear. If the parameter still exists in the v23 types, restore it.

The `invoice.payment_succeeded` branch now reads `invoice.parent?.subscription_details?.subscription`. Stripe builds webhook payloads with the webhook endpoint's configured API version, not the SDK's pin. If the endpoint is still on a pre-basil version, `parent` is absent. `retrieve` then gets `undefined` and throws, the handler returns 500, and Stripe retries until it gives up. The old `session.subscription` read happened to work against old payloads. The endpoint version needs aligning, or the code should fall back to the legacy `invoice.subscription` field.

Pre-existing issue, not caused by this diff. The early return at line 28 casts every event to a Checkout Session and checks `metadata.userId`. Invoice objects normally don't carry that metadata, so the `invoice.payment_succeeded` branch, including the newly rewritten code, may never run. Renewals would then never update `stripeCurrentPeriodEnd`. It is worth knowing the migrated path may be dead code.

`subscription.items.data[0].current_period_end` at lines 47 and 72 drops the optional chaining used on the `price.id` line just above. An empty items array would throw a TypeError instead of writing undefined. Low risk for single-item subscriptions.

stripe 23 declares `engines.node >=20` (from the lockfile). The deployment runtime must be Node 20+; nothing in the checks confirms that. Nine major versions are skipped at once. Other behaviour changes between v14 and v23 that typecheck can't catch (retries, defaults, error shapes) are not reviewed here.

The test only asserts on source strings, such as `payment_method_types` being absent and the new field paths being present. It proves nothing about runtime behaviour, webhook payload shape or Checkout. The stripe-migration check passing is a text check, not a functional one.

Replay a test checkout.session.completed and an invoice.payment_succeeded event with `stripe trigger` against the deployed route. Verify that stripeCurrentPeriodEnd is written to the DB.
Verify that the hosting runtime is Node 20 or later.
